description: A green plate sits in the middle on a red surface, with toy grapes to the right, a yellow pepper to the left, and other small items like a bun and blocks nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips the bunch of grapes as the right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the plate, then lowers and releases the grapes onto the center of the green plate, leaving the hand hovering nearby.
